dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, irregular light-toned perimeters against a dark dorsal-lateral background. Edges are non-uniform and jagged, showing a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior to the lighter, thin-walled interior rings in the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse to moderate concentration of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the anterior region and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli along the mid-dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct lateral 'O' structures in the mid-body form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary vertex located centrally and the secondary vertices extending dorsally and posteriorly.
